request: Prototype an Electronic Warfare fusion demonstration for the UK Ministry of Defence Joint Electronic Warfare Operational Support Cell (JEWOSC). Pull a live snapshot of civil ADS-B state vectors over UK & NW Europe (lat 48-61, lon -8 to 8) from OpenSky Network as an unclassified proxy for a cooperative-track feed. Fuse each row with a synthetic Electronic Order of Battle library keyed on airframe class (fighter / awacs / isr / transport / rotary / drone / unknown) to derive representative RF parametrics (band, centre frequency, PRI, PW, ERP) and a notional operating mode. Compute range/bearing/aspect from an own-ship reference (RAF Odiham, 51.3762N, -1.3086E) and Friis-model received signal power at own-ship (dBm). Assign a categorical threat_band (Non-hostile / Search / Track / Engage / Critical) that presents in an operational context. All emitter parametrics are notional; the EOB library is synthetic and illustrative — no classified reference material is used. Publish to 'Prep Agent / 31 - MOD JEWOSC EW Fusion Demo' on Tableau Server. Intended audience: JEWOSC analysts evaluating Tableau against complex Defence EW datasets, data-fusion workflows, and operator-facing visualisation.

sources.name: OpenSky UK/NW-Europe Live States
sources.description: OpenSky Network /api/states/all endpoint, bbox-filtered to the UK and NW-Europe SAR/EW theatre (lamin=48, lamax=61, lomin=-8, lomax=8). Each row = one aircraft state vector at the snapshot time. Public, keyless. Snapshot-only; refresh hourly.

args.name: EW Fusion
args.description: Fuses ADS-B state vectors with a synthetic Electronic Order of Battle library keyed on airframe class. Adds emitter class, primary emitter, RF band, centre frequency (GHz), PRI (us), PW (us), ERP (dBW), notional mode, own-ship range/bearing/aspect, Friis-model received power (dBm) at own-ship, and a categorical threat_band (Non-hostile / Search / Track / Engage / Critical). Emitter parametrics are notional and illustrative — no classified source. Own-ship reference: RAF Odiham (51.3762N, -1.3086E).

outputs.name: MOD JEWOSC EW Fusion
outputs.description: Fused EW picture for a JEWOSC analyst view. One row per airborne track in the UK / NW-Europe bbox at snapshot time. Track fields from OpenSky ADS-B: icao24, callsign, origin_country, longitude, latitude, baro_altitude (m), velocity (m/s), true_track (deg true), vertical_rate (m/s), geo_altitude, squawk, spi, position_source, time_position (epoch s), last_contact (epoch s), on_ground. Fusion outputs: emitter_class (fighter/awacs/isr/transport/rotary/drone/unknown), primary_emitter (notional payload name), rf_band (L/S/C/X/Ku/EHF/VHF-UHF), centre_freq_ghz, pri_us, pw_us, erp_dbw, mode (search/track/target/passive/silent), range_nm (from own-ship), bearing_deg (from own-ship, 0=N), aspect_deg (0=nose-on, 180=tail-on), rx_dbm (Friis free-space at own-ship), threat_band (Non-hostile/Search/Track/Engage/Critical), fusion_confidence (0..1), own_ship_label. Emitter parametrics are notional and illustrative. Source: OpenSky Network. Refresh: hourly.
